Jordan — thanks for the manifest. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Ingest: presigned S3 is our preference (we host the bucket for the short staging window). If Vendr prefers SFTP for any tooling reasons that's OK — see Priyom's note below.
- Canonical map: attached is our current evidence_map_v1.xlsx. It uses the internal artifact IDs we reference in OneTrust.
- Scope: agree with minimal scope (SOC 2, CAIQ, KMS rotation proof). No app logs for this pass.

Action items:
1) Priyom: can you confirm presigned S3 details (prefix, TTL) and whether object metadata will include CAIQ tags?
2) Jordan: once we confirm TTL we'll upload a sample batch to the s3 location and share a presigned manifest for Vendr ingestion.
3) Naomi/Ben: can you confirm the governance owners we should add in Vendr (read-only vs steward)?

Thanks — I'll coordinate the upload window for Wed/Thu this week.

Camila Reyes

Redwood Inference

Camila / Jordan — technical details below.

- S3 prefix: s3://redwood-inference-evidence/acme/onboarding/2026-02-09/
- Presigned TTL: 72 hours for manifest objects, 24 hours for individual artifact downloads (we can extend to 7 days if Vendr needs it longer).
- Metadata tags: will add: caig.framework=CAIQv3, caig.control=CCM-xxxx (we'll populate control IDs per the attached PDF mapping).
- Permissions: objects uploaded by our pipeline will be set to private; presigned URLs will be generated per manifest.

Attached: onetrust_caiq_mapping.pdf (PDF) — initial mapping from our artifact IDs to CAIQ fields. This is intentionally lightweight for the first pass.

Jordan: if you confirm you can fetch artifacts using presigned GETs with 24h TTL we'll coordinate the sample upload tomorrow AM.

Hi all — OneTrust team here. A couple notes from the CAIQ ingestion side: 

- Minimal CAIQ mapping is fine for an initial sync, but please ensure (1) evidence types are tagged (policy, screenshot, certificate) and (2) the artifact timestamps are preserved in object metadata.
- For SOC 2 items we prefer a single consolidated PDF per control when possible; small artifacts (e.g., a single-page cert) are OK as separate files.

We can run a quick validation sweep after the sample upload and report back with any missing fields.

Thanks,
Priya (OneTrust Integrations)
